skills.name: diataxis
skills.description: Audits and restructures documentation into the Diátaxis modes — tutorials, how-to guides, reference and explanation — without breaking links.

skills.name: engaging-hybrid-compute
skills.description: Splits a research project between a laptop and MIT's Engaging cluster: edit locally, run Slurm jobs on the cluster, and sync code and results through a private git repo.

skills.name: figpress-apps
skills.description: Builds an interactive webapp for a scientific paper with figpress-apps: exports the paper's arrays, ports the per-interaction science to tested JavaScript, composes linked views, and publishes a static site plus a single archivable HTML file that also runs in notebooks.

skills.name: figpress-apps-upgrade
skills.description: Moves a figpress-apps webapp to a newer figpress-apps version by applying the changelog's migration notes in order, then rebuilds and re-checks that the app still reproduces the paper's numbers.

skills.name: quax
skills.description: Writes, reviews and debugs JAX code that uses quax: custom array-like types such as physical units, sparse and low-rank arrays, quaxify, and the dispatch rules that make them work.

skills.name: submit-hybrid-compute
skills.description: Splits a research project between a laptop and MIT's subMIT cluster: edit locally, run Slurm jobs on the submit partition, and sync code and results through a private git repo.

skills.name: syw-adopt-overleaf
skills.description: Moves an existing paper, with a live Overleaf project and a private git repository, into a fresh showyourwork repository: backup first, regenerated figures and numbers compared against the old PDF, every irreversible step approved by the author, and the old history kept private.

skills.name: syw-overleaf-dropbox
skills.description: Guides writing a paper with showyourwork and Overleaf, using the Dropbox copy of the Overleaf project as the local text mirror: where to edit text versus code, how a build pushes figures and numbers, and the stalls and silent non-builds to expect.

skills.name: syw-site
skills.description: Adds a docs site to a showyourwork paper: its numbers, figures and interactive figpress-apps webapps, built by the paper's own pipeline and published at nstarkman.space with the website's layout, kept private until arXiv.

skills.name: syw-site-upgrade
skills.description: Moves a paper's docs site to a newer syw-site release by applying the changelog's migration notes in order, refreshing the scaffold, rebuilding and checking that the site still shows the paper's numbers.

skills.name: unxt
skills.description: Writes, reviews and debugs code that uses unxt quantities in JAX: units, dimensions and unit systems, conversions, and passing quantities through JAX and quax transformations.
